tasks.title: Flaky budgeted-prewarm test (test_budgeted_prewarm_equals_batch[1e-05])

agent_runs.label: M4-11 flaky prewarm test + P12-06 dataset survey + diagram 15 check

tasks.notes: Root cause: the test, not the decoder. The failing assert was `assert seen` (on_prewarm steps ran). With a 1e-5 s budget measured from the start of push_frames, beam.push alone usually uses the budget, so on_prewarm steps run only in rare pushes under 10 us (no load: 2 of ~130 prewarms per stream finished, seen = 10; under load seen = 0 in 1 of 3 runs). Decisions never depend on timing: the budget only decides how much of a pure memo (alignment pairs, LM rows, word caches) is filled; finalize recomputes any missing entry with the same function. Checked with an adversarial fake clock: 30 random schedules x 4 streams equal batch. Fix: injectable `CTCBeamSpec.clock` (default time.perf_counter) and `IncrementalPrefixBeam.prewarm(clock=...)`; the real-clock test now asserts results only; new deterministic tests test_budgeted_prewarm_fake_clock (schedules random / bursty / expired / frozen x 4 seeds; equality + coverage asserts) and test_beam_prewarm_fake_clock_cuts_mid_loop (deadline cut after 0..11 alignments). 50/50 runs of the budget tests under 8 busy loops (background class); full suite 650 passed / 9 skipped.

tasks.title: Signed or external anchor of the ledger head
tasks.notes: Done 2026-11-17 (code `b268203`): module `fidetype.trust.anchor` (Ed25519 through the optional extra `[sign]` = `cryptography`, Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause; in `[dev]`): `generate_key`, `sign_anchor`, `check_signature`, `verify_anchored` (signature + key id, ledger id, anchored entry seq + hash, head = anchor unless `allow_growth`, whole chain). Anchor schema `fidetype.ledger-anchor/1.0`. CLI `keygen` (never overwrites; private key owner-only), `anchor --sign-key-file | --sign-key-env`, `verify --anchor --public-key [--allow-growth]`; a signed anchor without a public key fails. Test: a rewritten ledger with a recomputed chain passes `verify` alone but fails against the signed anchor; a re-signed anchor with another key fails. Redaction keeps anchors valid. External option documented (RFC 3161 via `openssl ts`, second host); no network call. Keys: throwaway keys in tests only. Docs section 4.1 / 4.2. New gap 54 = P5-16. Open gap 48 (registered 2026-11-17 by P5-03). Follow-up of P5-03, M2-09. Source: anchor is a plain JSON file (tamper-evident, not tamper-proof). Done when: the anchor can be signed (e.g. Ed25519, key outside the ledger) or sent to an external store (RFC 3161 timestamp or a second host), verify checks it, and a test shows a rewritten ledger with a recomputed chain fails against a signed anchor. Roadmap: wiki/questions/roadmap-standard.md#p5-14-signed-or-external-anchor-of-the-ledger-head

tasks.title: Licence gate for input-event exporters
tasks.notes: Open gap 61 (registered 2026-11-18 by P5-18). Follow-up of P5-18. DONE 2026-11-18: decision written (FEP-0010 decision 6, FEP-0006 section 4 rule 6): yes, an input-event exporter can refuse a research-only stream, per stream by its header keys. On a jsonl/stdout exporter whose types has an input event type, refuse_research_only judges each stream by its header (fidetype.trust.licence.stream_licence of meta, the same flags a trust layer copies into input.research_only) and drops a refused stream whole (header and every event of the same stream key up to its end). No key, or an event before any header: unknown licence, the P5-18 unknown_licence rule (refuse by default, pass exports). data.research_only = false without data.licence is research only (FEP-0010), also with pass. Counters research_only_streams_refused, research_only_events_refused, licence_unknown_streams_refused, licence_unknown_events_refused; one log line per kind (no text, no session id). Items never changed (rule 1). A refused stream writes no file: per-session {session} files open at the first item; a single-path jsonl with the gate opens at its first exported item. Decisions-only exporters let input events pass (no stream counters). P5-18 config error (option on an input-event exporter) removed. Tests tests/test_input_event_licence_gate.py (CC-BY-NC stream writes no file, single and per-session path; CC0 stream writes byte-identical files; unknown both ways; three-stream pipeline keeps only the CC0 file; unit per-stream state; config errors).
